item.title: ‘Rahul Gandhi Misleading The Nation’: Piyush Goyal hits back at India-US trade deal criticism
item.description: Union Minister Piyush Goyal hit back at Rahul Gandhi’s criticism of the India–US trade deal, accusing him of misleading the public as US tariffs on Indian goods were cut sharply from 50% to 18% under the new agreement.

item.title: ‘SIR happening only in non-BJP states, AI being misused’: Mamata Banerjee lashes at EC again
item.description: West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee accused the Election Commission of targeting Opposition-ruled states through a rushed voter roll revision, alleging mass deletions, misuse of AI and disrespect during talks with the Chief Election Commissioner.

item.title: DGCA advises Air India to reinforce crew on procedures, after fuel switch concern
item.description: DGCA flags potential fuel control switch risk on Air India Boeing 787, advises crew training after inspections confirm no mechanical fault; improper handling could move switch from RUN to CUTOFF, regulators say.

item.title: MLAs, MPs gather at SP leader Dharmendra Yadav’s residence to mark his birthday; Watch video
item.description: Samajwadi Party MP Dharmendra Yadav’s birthday turned into a political meet as several MLAs and MPs gathered at his Delhi residence. Beyond wishes and bouquets, the event sparked discussions on strategy, unity and the party’s future roadmap.

item.title: ‘If Pakistan Doesn’t Relent And Play Against India…’: ICC warns of legal action from broadcasters
item.description: ICC has warned the Pakistan Cricket Board of possible legal action from broadcasters and a revenue loss of nearly USD 35 million if Pakistan goes ahead with its boycott of the India match at the T20 World Cup in Colombo.

item.title: ‘6:30 AM In Office Or Else…’: Gen Z’s savage reply to manager wins internet; Full story here
item.description: A Gen Z employee’s calm refusal to come to office at 6:30 am for a “virtual meeting” has gone viral, sparking debate over rigid office rules, post-pandemic flexibility and whether location should matter more than attendance.

item.title: Why you should never sit down immediately after a meal? Explained
item.description: Sitting down right after a meal may feel relaxing, but it can slow digestion, trigger acid reflux, cause bloating and spike blood sugar levels. Experts explain why staying upright or taking a short walk after eating is better for your health.

item.title: Bengaluru: After Party, 15-year-old falls to death from building; Pub booked for serving alcohol
item.description: A Bengaluru teenager’s night out with friends ended in tragedy after he fell from his apartment building. Police say alcohol consumption at a city pub may have played a role, triggering legal action and a wider probe into underage drinking.

item.title: Ghaziabad Tragedy: Three minor sisters die by suicide; Online game angle under probe
item.description: The girls jumped from the balcony of their ninth-floor apartment around 2 AM, reportedly holding hands. Residents of the colony rushed to the spot after hearing a loud sound and immediately informed the police.

item.title: WB: CM Mamata Banerjee reaches Supreme Court as SIR hearing continues under tight security
item.description: The high-profile matter has drawn significant attention, prompting enhanced security deployment to ensure smooth proceedings. Senior officials remained stationed in the vicinity while entry and movement were closely monitored.
